### New and Notable
Metaculus launched the AI Existential Risk Explorer tool created by Director of Forecasting Ryan Beck. The site displays how forecasters assess AI-caused catastrophe and extinction risks. Dedicated x-risk forecasters on the platform currently price extinction risk at 22 percent while professional forecasters price it at 7.5 percent.

Source: https://x.com/metaculus/status/2102780872055574713
